newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fischler proposes rice tenders to solve US quota dispute.
newsitem.headline: Fischler proposes rice tenders to solve US quota dispute.

text.p: Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler has proposed a tender system to help resolve a dispute with Washington over duty-free imports of U.S. rice, a Commission spokesman said on Wednesday.
Last week the U.S. filed a complaint with the World Trade Organisation, saying that the EU's import tariff system for grains, including rice, infringed free trade rules.
Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler wrote last week to his U.S. counterpart Dan Glickman suggesting an adjudication system which would help solve the problem of cross-subsidisation, the spokesman said.

EU rice producers have complained that U.S. exporters will use the duty-free concession, granted to compensate for trade losses after Austria, Sweden and Finland joined the EU, to subsidise non-quota rice exports.
The spokesman said the issue would be raised during talks with a U.S. team led by Glickman's trade adviser Paul Drazek in Brussels next Tuesday.
